build_MeanField_model: build a MeanField CRF model with spatial and chromatic sigma parameters for bilateral or trilateral filtering
create_BilateralCRF_wrapper: create a BilateralCRF wrapper that initializes a MeanField filter with non-temporal configuration
create_TrilateralCRF_wrapper: create a TrilateralCRF wrapper that initializes a MeanField filter with temporal configuration enabled
run_MeanField_forward: run the MeanField forward pass to perform meanfield iterations with pairwise potential and unary addition
review_MeanField_initialize_coords: review the MeanField initialize_coords method that builds trilateral grid coordinates and sparse mappings
